name: All-Pay Auction
summary: Auction where every bidder pays their bid, but only the highest bidder wins the prize.
rules_text: Each player has a private valuation for a single prize. Simultaneously, each player submits a non-negative bid, without seeing others' bids or valuations. The highest bid wins the prize. If there is a tie for highest, the winner is chosen randomly among tied bidders. All players pay their own bid regardless of winning. A player's payoff is their valuation if they win minus their bid, otherwise minus their bid. The player with the highest payoff wins, or payoffs are scored.
rating_reason: All-pay auction is specific bidding game with hidden bids, fits engine.
